Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:11:1.hebrew: כי הדר ביה טעמא אחרינא הוא - הא דאמר דכי הדר ביה הרשות בידו, לאו משום דעד השתא לאו כיד בעל הבית הוא, אלא טעמא אחרינא הוא, שאינו שלו כעבד, שאם בא לעזוב לו שכרו מכאן ואילך ולחזור בו, יחזור בו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:11:1.english: When he retracts, it is a different reason - That which he said that when he retracts, he has the right [to do so] is not because until now he is not like the hand of the employer; rather, it is a different reason — that he does not belong to him like a slave, for if he wishes to forgo his wages from now on and retract, he may retract.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:12:1.hebrew: ואם תאמר משנתינו - דקתני "אני זכיתי בה" זכה בה, ומשמע לן "אני זוכה בה עכשיו" זכה בה, ואע"פ שהגביה לצורך חבירו — היינו טעמא, משום דקתני ואמר לחבירו "תנה לי", ולא אמר "זכה אתה לי בהגבהתך". נמצא שלא עשאו שליח להקנות בהגבהתה עד שעת נתינה, והרי קודם נתינה הדר בו זה משליחותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:12:1.english: And if you say [what about] our Mishnah - For it teaches, "[If he said,] 'I have acquired it,' he acquires it," and it implies to us [that he meant], "I am acquiring it now," [and thus] he acquires it, even though he lifted it for his fellow's sake — this is the reason: because it teaches, "and he said to his fellow, 'Give it to me,'" and he did not say, "Acquire [it] for me through your lifting." Thus it emerges that he did not make him an agent to confer ownership through its lifting, [but rather] until the time of giving; and behold, before the giving, this one retracted from his agency.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:1.hebrew: קונות לו - אם יש סביבותיו דבר הפקר, אין אחר רשאי לתופסו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:1.english: Acquire for him - If there is an ownerless object around him, another [person] is not permitted to seize it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:2.hebrew: אמר אביי מותיב ר' חייא - עלה תיובתא ממתניתין דמסכת פיאה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:2.english: Abaye said: Rabbi Chiya raises an objection - a refutation against it from the Mishnah of Tractate Pe'ah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:3.hebrew: ואמר רבא מותיב ר' יעקב - עלה ממתניתין דסדר נזיקין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:14:3.english: And Rava said: Rabbi Yaakov raises an objection - against it, from a Mishnah of the Order of Nezikin.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:15:1.english: [If he] took - One of the poor.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:15:2.english: Some of the pe'ah - Which he had already gathered.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:15:3.english: And threw (it) on the rest - In order to acquire [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:16:1.english: Let [them] acquire for him - Regarding [the case of] "he fell upon it," [let] the four cubits that the Rabbis instituted for him [acquire it for him].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:19:1.hebrew: בנפילה ניחא ליה דנקני - לא נתכוין לקנות בתורת תקנת חכמים, כסבור שנפילתו יפה לו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:19:1.english: By falling, it is satisfactory for him to acquire - He did not intend to acquire by way of the ordinance of the Sages, thinking that his falling is better for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:1:1.hebrew: רבנן היא - ואשמועינן רישא דהיכא דזכי ביה איהו אמרינן מגו, וסיפא אשמועינן דהיכא דלא זכי ביה איהו, מגו דאי בעי זכי לא אמרי':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:1:1.english: It is [the opinion of] the Rabbis - And the first clause teaches us that where he himself acquires it, we say migu [since he acquires it for himself, he can acquire it for another]; and the latter clause teaches us that where he himself does not acquire it, we do not say migu that if he wanted he could acquire [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:1:2.english: This - whose [opinion] is the Mishnah here?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:2:1.hebrew: דאמר תחילה - האי "אני זכיתי בה" דקאמר, תחילה קאמר ליה: "מתחילה הגבהתיה לצורכי ולא לצרכך". ולעולם המגביה מציאה לחבירו קנה חבירו, דומיא דמעני לעני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:2:1.english: Where he said [it] at the outset - This [statement of] "I have acquired it" that he says, he says to him at the outset: "From the outset I lifted it for my own needs and not for your needs." And indeed, one who lifts a found object for his fellow, his fellow acquires [it], similar to [the case of] from a poor person for a poor person.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:1.hebrew: הכי נמי מסתברא - דזכיתי תחילה משעת הגבהה קאמר מתני':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:1.english: So too, it is reasonable - That the Mishnah is saying "I acquired [it] at the outset" from the time of lifting.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:2.hebrew: מדקתני סיפא כו' - ואי תחילה דסיפא לאו משעת הגבהה קאמר, אלא אני זכיתי תחילה — קודם שנתתיה לך נתכוונתי לזכות בה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:2.english: Since it teaches in the last clause, etc. - And if "at the outset" of the last clause does not mean from the time of lifting, rather "I acquired [it] at the outset" — before I gave it to you I intended to acquire it:

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:3.hebrew: למה לי - למיתנא בה "תחילה"? פשיטא, דאפילו לא אמר "תחילה" בפירוש, מסתמא תחילה קאמר; דמי מצי למימר "אני זוכה בה עכשיו"? והלא אינה בידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:3.english: Why do I need - to teach in it [the word] "at the outset"? It is obvious that even if he did not say "at the outset" explicitly, he presumably meant at the outset; for could he say, "I am acquiring it now"? After all, it is not in his possession!

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:4.hebrew: אלא לאו הא קמ"ל - דרישא דמתני', דקתני זכה בה, בדאמר "תחילה". ואשמועינן סיפא, דאם משנתנה לו טען לו אותה טענה ואמר "אני הגבהתיה מתחילה לצורכי", לא אמר כלום, דגלי דעתיה כשנתנה לו דאדעתיה דהאי אגבהה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:3:4.english: Rather, isn’t it teaching us this - That the first clause of the Mishnah, which teaches "he acquired it," [refers to a case] where he said "at the outset." And the last clause teaches us that if, after he gave it to him, he made that same claim to him and said, "I lifted it at the outset for my own purposes," he has said nothing, because he revealed his intention when he gave it to him that he had lifted it on behalf of this [rider].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:4:1.english: And the other - Rav Nachman says to you that [the Mishnah] taught "at the outset" [in] the latter clause.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:4:2.hebrew: לגלויי רישא - למימר דוקא קתני; מדסיפא תחילה קתני ורישא לא תנא, דוקא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:4:2.english: To shed light on the first clause - To say that [the Mishnah] taught [it] specifically; since the latter clause teaches "at the outset" and the former clause does not teach [it], it is specific.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:4:3.hebrew: סיפא - דלא אפשר בלא תחילה, אמר "אני זכיתי תחילה קודם שנתתיה לך", לא אמר כלום, דגלי דעתיה כשנתנה לו דאדעתא דהאי אגבהה. ורישא דלא אמר תחילה, ואפ"ה זכה בה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:4:3.english: The last clause - For it is impossible without [saying] "at the outset": [if] he said, "I acquired [it] at the outset, before I gave it to you," he has said nothing, because he revealed his intention when he gave it to him that he lifted it on behalf of this [rider]. And the first clause [is a case] where he did not say "at the outset," and even so he acquired it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:1.hebrew: הוי תופס לבעל חוב במקום שחב לאחרים - כאדם הבא מאליו ותופס ממון חבירו בשביל חוב שיש לאחר עליו, ובא לקדם עד שלא יתפסנו בעל חוב אחר, ונמצא תופס זה חב בתפיסתו זאת את הנושים האחרים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:1.english: It is [a case of] one who seizes for a creditor in a situation where he disadvantages others - Like a person who comes on his own and seizes his fellow's property for a debt that another [person] has against him, and comes to act first before another creditor seizes it; and thus this one who seizes disadvantages the other creditors through this seizure of his.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:2.hebrew: חב לאחרים - מפסיד את האחרים, כמו אין חבין לאדם (כתובות דף יא.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:2.english: Disadvantages others - He causes loss to the others, like "one may not act to a person's disadvantage" (Ketubot 11a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:3.hebrew: לא קנה - כדאמר בכתובות, דלאו כל כמיניה להיות קופץ מאליו וחב לאלו, מאחר שלא עשאו אותו הנושה שליח לתפוס:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:6:3.english: [He] does not acquire - As it says in Ketubot, it is not within his power to jump in on his own and disadvantage these [others], since that creditor did not make him an agent to seize [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:8:1.hebrew: נכש עמי היום - דלא נשכר עמו אלא לניכוש ועידור, וכשהגביה המציאה אין זה ממלאכת בעל הבית, וקנאה פועל. והוא ינכה לו משכרו שכר פעולת ניכוש ועידור כל שעת הגבהה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:8:1.english: Weed with me today - For he was hired by him only for weeding and tilling, and when he lifted the found item, this is not [part] of the employer's work, so the laborer acquires it. And he [the employer] deducts from his wages the pay for the work of weeding and tilling [for] the entire time of the lifting.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:8:2.hebrew: אמר לו עשה עמי מלאכה היום - כל מלאכה שהוא עושה, מלאכת בעל הבית היא, וקנה בעל הבית. אלמא המגביה מציאה לחבירו, קנה חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 10a:8:2.english: [If] he said to him, "Do work with me today" - Any work that he does is the employer's work, and the employer acquires [it]. Evidently, [when] one lifts up a found object for his fellow, his fellow acquires [it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:10:1.hebrew: יכול לחזור בו אפי' בחצי היום - וא"ת: ומאי קמ"ל? והלא בפרק האומנין (לקמן בבא מציעא דף עז.) לא פליגי רבי דוסא ורבנן, אלא דר' דוסא סבר דיד פועל על התחתונה, ורבנן סברי דידו על העליונה, אבל לכולהו יכול לחזור בו! וי"ל, דקמ"ל דיכול לחזור בו וידו על העליונה כרבנן — אפילו אם נתייקרו פועלים בחצי היום לאחר שחזר בו, לא יפחתו לו מחצי שכרו. ולכך מייתי מילתיה דרב, דכיון דידו על העליונה, א"כ אין ידו כיד בעל הבית. וכן מוכיח בפרק האומנין (שם) דסובר כרבנן בשכיר יום, ולא בקבלנות:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:10:1.english: "He may retract even at midday" - And if you should ask: What is [Rav] teaching us? For in the chapter HaOmanin (later in Bava Metzia 77a), Rabbi Dosa and the Rabbis only disagree in that Rabbi Dosa holds that the laborer has the lower hand, whereas the Rabbis hold that he has the upper hand, but according to all of them he may retract! One can answer that [Rav] is teaching us that he may retract and has the upper hand like the Rabbis — [so that] even if [the wages of] laborers increased at midday after he retracted, they do not deduct from his half-day's wage. And therefore [the Gemara] cites Rav's statement, because since he has the upper hand, if so, his hand is not like the hand of the employer. And so it proves in the chapter HaOmanin (there) that [Rav] holds like the Rabbis regarding a day-laborer, and not regarding piecework:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:11:1.hebrew: כי לי בני ישראל עבדים - נ"ל דמ"מ מותר אדם להשכיר עצמו, דדוקא עבד עברי, שאינו יכול לחזור בו ואינו יוצא קודם זמנו אלא בשטר שחרור, עובר משום "עבדי הם":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:11:1.english: "For to Me the children of Israel are slaves" - It appears to me that in any case a person is permitted to hire himself out, for only a Hebrew slave, who cannot retract and does not go free before his [appointed] time except with a bill of manumission, transgresses on account of "They are My slaves."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:12:1.hebrew: א"ר יוחנן המגביה מציאה לחבירו קנה חבירו - ואע"ג דאית ליה לרבי יוחנן בפרק הכותב (כתובות דף פד: ושם ד"ה ואמר) ובפ"ק דגיטין (דף יא: ושם ד"ה התופס) תופס לבע"ח לא קני — היינו דוקא היכא דלא שייך מגו דזכי לנפשיה, דאין הלוה חייב כלום לתופס; אבל במציאה דאיכא מגו, קנה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:12:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said: One who lifts a found item on behalf of his fellow, his fellow acquires [it] - And even though Rabbi Yoḥanan holds in the chapter [entitled] HaKotev (Ketubot 84b, and there, s.v. VeAmar) and in the first chapter of Gittin (11b, and there, s.v. HaTofes) [that] one who seizes [property] on behalf of a creditor does not acquire [it] — that is specifically where [the principle of] migo, [i.e.,] that he could acquire [it] for himself, does not apply, since the borrower owes nothing to the one seizing; but in [the case of] a found item, where there is [a] migo [that he could have acquired it for himself], he acquires [it on behalf of his fellow]:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:12:2.hebrew: ולא אמר זכי לי - וא"ת: דבפ"ק דגיטין (שם) קאמר ר' יוחנן: "כל האומר תנו כאומר זכו"? וי"ל דשאני התם, דדעת אחרת מקנה אותו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:12:2.english: And he did not say, "Acquire [it] for me" - And if you ask: In the first chapter of Gittin (there), Rabbi Yoḥanan says, "Whoever says 'Give' is like one who says 'Acquire'"? One can answer that there it is different, because another's intent [i.e., a third party] transfers ownership to him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:14:1.hebrew: ארבע אמות קונות לו בכל מקום - וא"ת: באלו נערות (כתובות דף לא: ושם ד"ה אי) דאמר גבי גונב כיס בשבת: "היה מגרר ויוצא, פטור", דאיסור שבת ואיסור גניבה באין כאחד; וקאמר: אי דאפקיה לרה"ר, איסור שבת איכא, איסור גניבה ליכא. ואמאי? הא ארבע אמות קונות לו! וי"ל דבגניבה לא תקינו רבנן דקני, אלא במציאה דלא ליתי לאנצויי, ובגט משום עיגונא. ולרב ששת דאמר בסמוך דברה"ר לא תקינו ארבע אמות, אתי שפיר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:14:1.english: Four cubits acquire for him everywhere - And if you ask: In [the chapter] Elu Ne'arot (Ketubot 31b, and there, s.v. I), where it says regarding one who steals a purse on Shabbat: "If he was dragging [it] and going out, he is exempt," because the prohibition of Shabbat and the prohibition of theft come simultaneously; and [the Gemara] says: If he took it out to the public domain, there is the prohibition of Shabbat, [but] there is no prohibition of theft. Why [is there no theft]? Surely [his] four cubits acquire [it] for him! One can answer that for theft the Sages did not institute that [four cubits] acquire; [rather, they instituted it] only for a lost item so that [people] would not come to quarrel, and for a bill of divorce because of [the concern of] iguna. And according to Rav Sheshet, who says shortly below that in the public domain they did not institute four cubits, it works out well.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:15:1.hebrew: מעבירין אותו הימנה - אפי' רשע לא מיקרי. ואע"ג דעני המהפך בחררה ובא אחר ונטלו נקרא רשע (קדושין דף נט. ושם ד"ה עני), היינו משום דאפשר ליה למיטרח ולמיזבן ארעא אחריתי; אבל במציאה או בהפקר דליכא למימר הכי, אפילו רשע לא מיקרי [וע"ע תוספות בבא בתרא דף כא: ד"ה מרחיקין]:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:15:1.english: They remove him from it - He is not even called a wicked person [for doing so]. And even though a poor person who is turning over a cake and another comes and takes it is called wicked (Kiddushin 59a, and there, s.v. ani), that is because he is able to exert himself and buy another piece of land; but with a found object or ownerless property, where one cannot say this, he is not even called wicked [see also Tosafot on Bava Batra 21b, s.v. marhikin].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:5:1.hebrew: רב נחמן ורב חסדא כו' - תימה, דבשלהי משילין (ביצה דף לט. ושם: ד"ה הכא) אמר: מילא מים ונתן לחבירו, רב ששת אמר כרגלי הממלא ור"נ אמר כרגלי מי שנתמלאו לו. ומסיק דבמגביה מציאה לחבירו פליגי, דמר סבר קנה ומר סבר לא קנה; ומשמע דלרב נחמן קנה חבירו, ולכך הוי כרגלי מי שנתמלאו לו. ורש"י גרס התם: מ"ס קני ומר סבר לא קני, ול"ג חבירו. וכולהו סברי דלא קני חבירו, אלא רב נחמן סבר דמגביה נמי לא קני, ולכך כשלקח חבירו ממנו קנאו [מן ההפקר, שמתכוין לקנות, אבל המגביה לא הגביה לקנות]; ורב ששת סבר דקנה הממלא, דכיון דלא קנה חבירו — הוא קנה, ולכך הוי כרגליו. ור"ת פי', דהתם רב נחמן מודה דקנה חבירו, דאינו חב לאחרים, שיש הרבה מים בבור. ועוד אומר ר"ת, דשפיר גרסינן "חבירו", וסבר ר"נ לא קנה חבירו כי הכא, וגם הממלא לא קנה, ולכך כשנתנם לו קנאם והוי כרגליו; ורב ששת סבר קני חבירו מטעם מגו דזכי לנפשיה, וכיון דלא קנה חבירו אלא מטעם דזכי לנפשיה, ואי הוה זכי לנפשיה הוי כרגליו, והשתא נמי דזכי לחבריה הוי כרגליו, ולא עדיף מיניה לענין תחומין, והוי כאילו זכי לנפשיה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:5:1.english: Rav Naḥman and Rav Ḥisda, etc. - [This is] astonishing, for at the end of [chapter] Mashilin (Beitzah 39a, and there s.v. Hakha) it states: [If] one drew water and gave [it] to his fellow, Rav Sheshet says [it is] like the feet of the one who drew [it], and Rav Naḥman says [it is] like the feet of the one for whom it was drawn. And [the Gemara there] concludes that they disagree regarding one who lifts a found item on behalf of his fellow, as one Master holds [that] he acquired [it] and one Master holds [that] he did not acquire [it]; and it is implied that according to Rav Naḥman, his fellow acquired [it], and therefore it is like the feet of the one for whom it was drawn. And Rashi's textual reading there is: One Master holds [that] he acquired [it] and one Master holds [that] he did not acquire [it], and we do not read "his fellow" [in the text]. And all of them hold that his fellow did not acquire [it], rather Rav Naḥman holds that the one who lifts [it] also did not acquire [it], and therefore when his fellow took it from him, he acquired it [from ownerless property, since he intends to acquire it, whereas the one who lifted it did not lift it to acquire it]; and Rav Sheshet holds that the one who drew [it] acquired [it], for since his fellow did not acquire [it], he acquired [it], and therefore it is like his feet. And Rabbeinu Tam explained that there Rav Naḥman concedes that his fellow acquired [it], because he does not disadvantage others, since there is plenty of water in the cistern. And Rabbeinu Tam further says that we properly read "his fellow" [in the text], and Rav Naḥman holds [that] his fellow did not acquire [it], just like here, and the one who drew [it] also did not acquire [it], and therefore when he gave them to him, he acquired them and it is like his feet; and Rav Sheshet holds [that] his fellow acquired [it] by reason of migo — since he could have acquired [it] for himself — and since his fellow only acquired [it] by reason that he could have acquired [it] for himself, and had he acquired [it] for himself it would have been like his feet, now too that he acquired [it] for his fellow it is like his feet, and he is no better than him with respect to Shabbat boundaries, and it is as if he acquired [it] for himself.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:6:1.hebrew: תופס לבע"ח במקום שחב לאחרים לא קני - מה שפרש"י משום דלא עשאו שליח, אין נראה; דבפ' הכותב (כתובות דף פד: ושם ד"ה את) משמע גבי עובדא דיימר בר חשו, דתופס לבע"ח במקום שחב לאחרים לא קני, אפילו עשאו שליח:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:6:1.english: One who seizes for a creditor in a situation where it disadvantages others does not acquire [it] - That which Rashi explained, [that it is] because he did not appoint him as an agent, does not seem [correct]; for in the chapter [entitled] HaKotev (Ketubot 84b, and there, s.v. at), it is implied regarding the incident of Yeimar bar Chashu that one who seizes for a creditor in a situation where it disadvantages others does not acquire [it] even if he appointed him as an agent.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:7:1.hebrew: איתיביה רבא לרב נחמן - אע"ג דלעיל (בבא מציעא ד' ח.) דחי רבא דיוקיה דרמי בר חמא, משמע דסבר לא קנה חבירו — שמא קבלה הכא מר"נ:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 10a:7:1.english: Rava raised an objection to Rav Nachman - Even though above (Bava Metzia 8a) Rava rejected Rami bar Hama's inference, [which] implies that he holds his fellow does not acquire [it] — perhaps he accepted it here from Rav Nachman.
